description: This Python source file is part of PyTorch's torch._inductor module, specifically the common.py file that defines core abstractions, utilities, and registration mechanisms for code generation backends in the inductor JIT compiler. It includes classes for managing kernel arguments, codegen symbols, backend registration, and various helper functions.

classes.name: FileBackedGraphModule
classes.description: Represents a FX GraphModule with associated compiled function and temporary file management for debugging.

classes.name: WorkspaceZeroMode
classes.description: Enum for managing the zero-initialization modes of workspaces used in kernel code generation.

classes.name: CodegenSymbol
classes.description: Abstract base class representing a symbolic variable used in code generation abstractions.

classes.name: WorkspaceArg
classes.description: Represents a workspace buffer used during kernel execution, with size, device, zeroing mode, and naming attributes.

classes.name: TritonScratchWorkspace
classes.description: Represents a Triton specific scratch workspace with size and dtype generation.

classes.name: TensorArg
classes.description: Data class representing a tensor argument for kernels, including buffer name, dtype, offset, aliasing info.

classes.name: SizeArg
classes.description: Data class representing size arguments.

classes.name: ConstexprArg
classes.description: Data class representing an argument with a compile-time constant value.

classes.name: TMADescriptorArg
classes.description: Describes a TMA (Tensor Memory Access) descriptor argument with api type, block shape, dtype.

classes.name: DeviceCodegen
classes.description: Holds scheduling and codegen classes/functions for a specific device backend.

classes.name: DeferredLine
classes.description: Represents a line of code that can be conditionally omitted if buffer is removed.

classes.name: BracesBuffer
classes.description: Indent buffer that manages braces for code formatting.

classes.name: InplacedBuffer
classes.description: Tuple indicating in-place buffer info with inner name and other associated names.

classes.name: ArgName
classes.description: Represent an argument's name and whether it is constexpr for code generation.

classes.name: RemovedArg
classes.description: Placeholder class indicating an argument buffer/variable has been removed.

classes.name: KernelArgs
classes.description: Class managing kernel argument buffers, sizevars, workspace, and related code generation functions.

classes.name: CSEVariable
classes.description: Represents a common subexpression variable, with tracking for usage, dtype, shape, and bounds.

classes.name: DataTypePropagation
classes.description: Handles deducing data types for nodes and graphs during code generation.

classes.name: PythonPrinter
classes.description: Custom sympy printer for code generation with optional simplification features.

classes.name: OpDecompositions
classes.description: Collection of static methods for decomposing operations into simpler or primitive forms.

classes.name: OpOverrides
classes.description: Provides operation overrides tailored for specific backends, including code string templates and unimplemented method stubs.

classes.name: OverridesData
classes.description: Data class capturing override implementations for specific operations across backends.

methods.name: get_wrapper_codegen_for_device

methods.name: get_custom_backend_pass_for_device
methods.description: Retrieves custom FXIR pass for a specific backend device, if any.

methods.name: get_custom_backend_config_for_device
methods.description: Retrieves custom configuration module for a specific backend device.

methods.name: index_prevent_reordering
methods.description: Adjusts index sequences to prevent reordering during optimization.

methods.name: register_device_op_overrides
methods.description: Associates a device string with custom operation overrides.

methods.name: get_device_op_overrides
methods.description: Retrieves the operation overrides for a specific device.

methods.name: deduce_output_dtype_by_name
methods.description: Deduces output data type based on operation name and input arguments.

methods.name: check_dtype
methods.description: Inline static check for dtype correctness in generated code.

methods.name: check_shape
methods.description: Inline static check for shape correctness.

methods.name: check_nan
methods.description: Inline static check for NaN or Inf in tensors.

methods.description: Class for propagating and deducing data types within a graph or subgraph.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Generates a new CSEVariable or fetches from cache, creating variables as needed, and emitting code lines to the buffer.

methods.description: Creates a new CSEVariable with a specified name.

methods.name: sort

methods.name: var_ranges

methods.name: bucketize

methods.name: indirect_assert

methods.name: check_bounds

methods.name: index_to_str
methods.description: Abstract method to convert an index expression to a string.
